gaps.jd_requirement: Experience with SaaS customer onboarding and CRM platforms
gaps.resume_weakness: Resume mentions 'customer service' but doesn't use 'SaaS', 'onboarding', or 'CRM' keywords
gaps.fix_strategy: In interview: 'While my resume says customer service, I've onboarded 50+ clients to our software platform and used CRM systems daily to track customer health metrics. I'm eager to deepen my SaaS expertise.'

gaps.resume_weakness: Resume shows 1 year customer service but doesn't mention renewals or upsells
gaps.fix_strategy: In interview: 'I have 1 year of customer-facing experience. While my role didn't include formal renewals ownership, I frequently identified upsell opportunities and referred them to account managers, resulting in $80K in pipeline.'

role_content_refined: Onboard new customers and drive product adoption
Monitor customer health and engagement metrics
requirements_refined: SaaS or tech industry background preferred
role_team_insights.rto_employee_reality: Flexible hybrid, mostly remote for individual contributors
role_team_insights.career_path_basis: HubSpot career ladder per Glassdoor and company site

offer_strategy.walk_away: Below $58K or no clear growth path
offer_strategy.script: I'm very excited about joining HubSpot and growing in customer success. Based on my 1 year of customer-facing experience where I onboarded 50+ clients and identified $80K in upsell opportunities, and given research showing Customer Success Associates ranging $55K-$72K, I'm hoping for $68K. I'm particularly interested in learning about the path to CSM roles. Would that work within your range?

questions.question: Tell me about a time you turned around an unhappy customer
questions.star_blueprint: A client was frustrated with implementation delays. I scheduled a call within 2 hours, acknowledged their concerns, and created a detailed recovery plan with weekly check-ins. They renewed 2 months later and gave us a 5-star review.
questions.resume_anchor: Resolved customer issues maintaining 92% satisfaction rate

questions.question: How would you identify when a customer is at risk of churning?
questions.interviewer_intent: Testing customer success thinking and data awareness
questions.star_blueprint: I'd monitor engagement metrics: login frequency, feature usage, support ticket volume, and NPS scores. Red flags include: no logins in 2 weeks, increased support tickets with frustration, or delayed renewals discussions. Early outreach is key.
questions.resume_anchor: Tracked customer engagement and proactively addressed concerns
